name: Firebomb · Death · Life
primary:
A projectile flies where you look and explodes in a 3.62-block radius on hit. Effects:
• Damage 4.5 ❤ fire + 2.25 ❤ arcane (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 21.6 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Arcane instability: −0.25 ❤ every 2 s for 6.75 s
• Withering: −0.5 ❤ per second for 6 s
• Life drain: 1 ❤ damage, you heal 0.52 ❤
• Heals 4 ❤
• Regeneration: +1.5 ❤ every 2 s for 10 s
